crossRefs.note: But the wicked shall perish. The enemies of Yahweh shall be like the beauty of the fields. They will vanish— vanish…
For wickedness burns like a fire. It devours the briers and thorns; yes, it kindles in the thickets of the forest, and…
Therefore they will be like the morning mist, and like the dew that passes away early, like the chaff that is driven…
The mountains melt like wax at the presence of Yahweh, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.
As when fire kindles the brushwood, and the fire causes the water to boil; Make your name known to your adversaries…
The mountains melt under him, and the valleys split apart, like wax before the fire, like waters that are poured down a…
You, even you, are to be feared. Who can stand in your sight when you are angry?
It’s burned with fire. It’s cut down. They perish at your rebuke.
The mountains quake before him, and the hills melt away. The earth trembles at his presence, yes, the world, and all…
Who can stand before his indignation? Who can endure the fierceness of his anger? His wrath is poured out like fire…
punishing those who don’t know God, and to those who don’t obey the Good News of our Lord Jesus,
who will pay the penalty: eternal destruction from the face of the Lord and from the glory of his might,
They told the mountains and the rocks, “Fall on us, and hide us from the face of him who sits on the throne, and from…
for the great day of his wrath has come; and who is able to stand?”

translations.web: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away. As wax melts before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.
translations.bsb: As smoke is blown away, You will drive them out; as wax melts before the fire, the wicked will perish in the presence of God.
translations.kjv: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away: as wax melteth before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.
translations.asv: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away: As wax melteth before the fire, So let the wicked perish at the presence of God.
